summary: Pioneer Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing the acquisition of The College Advisor of New York, a college admissions advisory firm. The registrant, Pioneer, acted as the acquirer. Terms such as price per share, valuation, or premium were not disclosed. Dr. Dean Skarlis, founder of the target, will head Pioneer's new College Advising Division as Vice President. No board recommendation or financial advisors were named. The transaction diversifies Pioneer beyond core banking into education advisory services, integrating college planning with financial strategy. Watch for integration execution and potential impact on Pioneer's earnings, though financial materiality remains unclear.
